narrative_flags.text: Labels the group a foreign subversion operation without supporting evidence.

required_facts.text: The Tiananmen Mothers is a group of relatives of people killed in the 1989 crackdown, associated with Ding Zilin.
The group seeks truth and accountability and faces restrictions on its activities.
